image.alt: Minute Realms original dV Giochi box photographed by cover artist Paweł Hordyniak

fairUse.rationale: Small cover crop from the original cover artist's product photograph identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: The illustrator's December 2017 post https://hordyniak.tumblr.com/post/168796577685/minute-realms-card-game-art-time-for-something says he painted the Minute Realms cards and cover for dV Giochi and shows his physical first-edition box with cards and rule sheet. The title-neutral box artwork matches the dV Giochi English 2017 rulebook at https://www.dvgiochi.com/giochi/minute-realms/download/MinuteRealms_Rules_ENG.pdf. This image crops the box from the artist's own product photograph. Reduced to 360 × 348 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited a castle is the first player.
officialTieBreak: Choose randomly if there is doubt about who qualifies.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The first player deals the round's cards and takes the first card-selection and building turn. Turns then proceed clockwise.
